Music from USB sticks

Proposal
1, implement. 30 complaint rows, 17 wishes: owners copied their CDs to USB sticks and lost playback with the new generation; several say USB only charges.
Horizon
H1. Software (media player and USB data path), possibly a hub change in the life-cycle impulse.
Domain
Infotainment & Digital Services
Markets
EU
Evidence level
B (the best level of the primary and supporting findings)
Status
proposed, version 1
Reference
REQ-F70-EU-ID-05 (the key of the decisions, the audit trail and the exports)

Statement

The USB-C ports shall play audio files from a USB stick, without requiring a smartphone.

Acceptance criteria

One row per market where expectations differ. Basis: evidence is a measured study value or a count; assumption is the agent's proposal for the product manager to set.

MarketMetricTargetHow measuredBasis
EUPlayback of MP3 and AAC from a FAT32 or exFAT USB stickYesFunction testevidence

    • i am really starting to enjoy the car now and like what bmw have done with the inside. the only thing i miss is usb contention.

      F70-1208 · Source A · GB · ICE · Defect, USB port, Malfunction · F70_feedback_hackathon.xlsx, row 2,335

    • parking the car is really a pain, the camera view and the sensors dont match up properly and the beeping noise is distracting. there are no usb ports, just a phone charger. the seating isnt that comfortable either. the dashboard is also distracting, with the radio showing no channel list, only a bunch of colourful icons.

      F70-1545 · Source A · GB · ICE · Defect, USB port, Malfunction · F70_feedback_hackathon.xlsx, row 2,982

    • i enjoy driving the car but a couple of things annoy me. the ai help is not great, some of the answers are too general. the handbook in the app has no search or index so finding anything specific is a pain. voice control still works randomly even after the software update. the fuel gauge is too small and should stand out more. for a car at this level you would expect a few things that are missing, like usb charging points in the rear and dual climate control. the manuals make it look like it has dual climate, but i had to go back to the dealership to be told the car doesnt have it as an option.

      F70-1114 · Source A · GB · ICE · Defect, USB port, Malfunction · F70_feedback_hackathon.xlsx, row 2,171

    • i had the f40 before and this one feels a big upgrade in how it rides, overall quality and performance. outside still looks like the premium level you expect, and the revised lights are definitely an improvement over the old model. the cabin is excellent, with the vinyl replacing leather being a really good touch as it is simple to keep clean and look after. lots of changes make it fantastic to drive, and the newer tech like reverse assist, park assist plus and the rear camera really help the experience. the infotainment display and driver binnacle are both excellent and can be set up easily, and the operating system works very well. i do really miss the auto dipping near side mirror though, it feels like a penny pinching move given how useful it was. and still no usb ports in the back!!!!

      F70-1848 · Source A · GB · ICE · Defect, USB port, Malfunction · F70_feedback_hackathon.xlsx, row 3,551
